applied.quote: You can submit Form 4547 at any time, including by e-filing it alongside your current-year income tax return or through trumpaccounts.gov when online elections open in mid-2026.
applied.replacement: You can submit Form 4547 at any time, including by e-filing it alongside your current-year income tax return or through trumpaccounts.gov, where online elections may be available starting in mid-2026.

applied.quote: For a child born after December 31, 2024 and before January 1, 2029, check line 7 in Part III to request the initial government contribution, or leave line 7 blank if the child only qualifies for the standard account election described in our guide on [how to open a Trump Account](/guides/how-to-open-a-trump-account/).
applied.replacement: For a child born after December 31, 2024 and before January 1, 2029, check line 7 in Part III to request the pilot program contribution, or leave line 7 blank if the child only qualifies for the standard account election described in our guide on [how to open a Trump Account](/guides/how-to-open-a-trump-account/).Trim
